name: cute-and-funny-world-of-kivotos
displayName: Cute and Funny World of Kivotos
description: The students of Kivotos, from Trinity to Millennium. 145 characters, with ARONA as your system admin.
author: breados17

welcome: Sensei! Welcome to Kivotos! ♪ I'm ARONA, and I look after everything here from the Shittim Chest.
The characters you picked are active, but time is paused, so nobody is spending any tokens yet. Choose a speed at the top of the screen when you're ready for the day to begin.
You can play as Sensei, as any student, or as nobody and just watch: pick from the bottom bar. Then talk from Chats, see where everyone is in World, and follow what happens in Timeline.
If you'd like anything changed, just ask me! I can add students, change who they are or build new places. Where should we start, Sensei?
